import argparse
import json

ITEMS = [
    {"name": "write report", "priority": 2},
    {"name": "backup db", "priority": 1},
    {"name": "call vendor", "priority": 3},
    {"name": "archive logs", "priority": 2},
]


def main(argv=None):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tasks")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="print as JSON")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    items = list(ITEMS)
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps({"items": items}))
    else:
        for it in items:
            print(f"{it['priority']} {it['name']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import json
import pytest
from tasks_cli.cli import main


def test_json(capsys):
    main(["--json"])
    out = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
    assert list(out) == ["items"] and len(out["items"]) == 4


def test_limit(capsys):
    main(["--limit", "2"])
    out = capsys.readouterr().out.strip().splitlines()
    assert out == ["2 write report", "1 backup db"]


def test_limit_zero_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
        main(["--limit", "0"])


def test_limit_negative_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
        main(["--limit", "-3"])


def test_sort_name(capsys):
    main(["--sort", "name"])
    out = capsys.readouterr().out.strip().splitlines()
    assert out == [
        "2 archive logs",
        "1 backup db",
        "3 call vendor",
        "2 write report",
    ]


def test_sort_priority_ties_broken_by_name(capsys):
    main(["--sort", "priority"])
    out = capsys.readouterr().out.strip().splitlines()
    assert out == [
        "1 backup db",
        "2 archive logs",
        "2 write report",
        "3 call vendor",
    ]


def test_limit_after_sort(capsys):
    main(["--sort", "priority", "--limit", "2"])
    out = capsys.readouterr().out.strip().splitlines()
    assert out == ["1 backup db", "2 archive logs"]


def test_limit_with_json(capsys):
    main(["--json", "--limit", "1"])
    out = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
    assert list(out) == ["items"] and len(out["items"]) == 1
    assert out["items"] == [{"name": "write report", "priority": 2}]


def test_sort_with_json(capsys):
    main(["--json", "--sort", "name"])
    out = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
    assert [it["name"] for it in out["items"]] == [
        "archive logs", "backup db", "call vendor", "write report",
    ]
